generate_sobol_points: generate space-filling sample points using a Sobol low-discrepancy sequence for a given set of dimensions and ranges
generate_halton_points: generate space-filling sample points using a Halton low-discrepancy sequence for a given set of dimensions and ranges
calculate_coverage_monte_carlo: calculate the coverage of data points in a high-dimensional space using Monte Carlo estimation with k-radius balls
calculate_coverage_grid: calculate the coverage of data points in a discretized grid space by counting occupied bins out of total possible bins
calibrate_radius_multiplier: calibrate the optimal radius multiplier for Monte Carlo coverage estimation using binary search on a Sobol point set
